shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/medical/recreation/modded-needs, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF/Helixien/VTE, Rimefeller), stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED 2026-07-19: RimefellerBridge and VEFPipeBridge both violated it in private helper signatures, caught one at a time because the dev-palette attribute scan dies at the FIRST unresolvable signature. All four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller — audited in one pass now; DBHWaterBridge was already compliant). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = Building_ABStairs.BaseClimbTicks (90) x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- Stairs carry PAWNS ONLY (tickerType Never, no comps). All utilities cross through dedicated utilityOnly links.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (replaces the battery/tank equalization model)
- **Vanilla power — vertical conduit**: CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader (transmitsPower, 0 base consumption). Master side (lower map uniqueID) recomputes every 15t: measures both nets excluding all AB links (live gain in watts, off-but-wanting consumer demand via Props.PowerConsumption, battery room), nets a single signed flow, sets PowerOutput +/- on the pair. Deficits served from far generation surplus AND far stored energy; leftover generation (never battery charge) tops up far batteries. Parallel conduits converge by subtracting other links' promised flow. No storage, no efficiency loss, no player battery needed. **Rimatomics electricity rides vanilla PowerNet, so it crosses through the conduit automatically** (its internal steam/coolant nets unverified — mod not installed).
- **VEF PipeSystem — vertical duct** (covers Vanilla Pipes Expanded, Helixien gas, VTE ACNet, any PipeNetDef): net pairs matched by def at the duct cell or cardinal neighbor; unmet demand (live + off-but-CanBeOn receivers) injected via PipeNet.ExtraProduction/ExtraConsumptionThisTick (public hooks, consumed once per 100t net tick — ordering-safe). No storage needed on either side. Secondary damped tank equalization. Duct carries no VEF comps; def gated by PatchOperationFindMod. Helper signatures object-typed.
- **DBH — vertical water pipe**: each end carries DBH CompPipe(Water) + hidden 100L CompWaterStorage, so the shaft IS a tower on both nets (wells/pumps fill it via DBH's own CompTick; fixtures drink from it — tankless levels work). Damped fill-fraction equalization via PullWater/PushWater. Sewage stays per-level (documented limitation).
- **Rimefeller — vertical chem pipe**: each end carries two hidden 100-unit CompStorageTank comps (Oil + Fuel), so the shaft is storage on both pipeline nets; oil and fuel fill fractions equalize via PullOil/PushCrude/PullFuel/PushFuel. Nets resolved through the link's own comps. Compile-time ref (installed, verified); def patch-gated. Helper signatures object-typed.
- Dispatcher ABPipeCompat: detection flags, per-def ext routing (bridgeWater/bridgeVef/bridgeChem), driven from ground LevelComp every 100t (VEF cadence).

## Sky surface model (round-15, VERIFIED runs #121-#123)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + sweep (TIME-SLICED: 4096 cells/tick; full sweep only at load).
- **Rooftop visual (VERIFIED #121)**: AB_RoofSurface renders with the VANILLA steel tile texture (Terrain/Surfaces/GenericFloorTile) tinted dark steel (0.32,0.32,0.32). Mockup contract at .modmixer/mockups/roof-target.png satisfied: tiles to the OUTER wall edge, roofed doorways covered, zero below bleed-through, sky things/floors on top.
- Decisions locked with user: steel tile look for ALL constructed roofs; freestanding unroofed walls stay visible from above; rooftop keeps FULL buildability (Light/Medium/Heavy).
- **Mountain edge (VERIFIED #123)**: every below rock sits under a natural roof, which the genstep maps to AB_MountainTop — measured #122: air=0, mountainTop=16995. The layered mountain-edge look is a fog-mirroring pair: the printed below-things layer prints under BOTH air and cap cells but only UNFOGGED lower things (vanilla's own bake rule, seeThroughFog honored), and the cap layer SKIPS its flat fill on cells whose below cell holds an explored rock face (no sky edifice) — printed rock texture reads through; fogged mass keeps the vanilla unexplored-fog fill. Exploring below live-updates the sky view (FogOfWar in the dirty mirror).
- **Sky auto-roof guard**: RoofSync-gated prefix on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.TryGenerateAreaNow — a sky room whose 8-way border contains AB_OpenAir counts as touching the map edge (auto-roof skipped, queued BuildRoof marks cleared); fully walled sky rooms auto-roof normally; manual designations untouched.

## See-below renderer (round-16: hybrid clone + fog-mirrored printed things + faux perspective)
- **Things content is PRINTED PER CELL, not cloned**: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings on the sky map reprints the lower map's map-mesh things into its own submeshes for cells that are AB_OpenAir OR AB_MountainTop on the sky, skipping things in lower-FOGGED cells. Covered cells (rooftop tiles, built floors) print nothing — roof opacity BY CONSTRUCTION. Same per-cell-filter idea Z-Levels beta proved, implemented independently (Thing.Print into a flag-gated layer; linked graphics resolve against the lower map's grids via parent.Map; drawn at forced band queues via LevelRenderer.DrawBelowSubMesh, queue stepped by real submesh altitude x14).
- **Faux-perspective depth transform (round-16, NEW)**: the ENTIRE below view (clone band + printed things via the shared BelowMatrix, mirrored dynamic pass via ApplyDrawShift in the DrawPos postfix) draws through one affine transform p' = k*p + (1-k)*cam + (0, BelowOffset, -depthShift). (a) Fixed down-screen shift (settings slider belowDepthShift 0-0.6 cells, default 0.25) detaches the ground from elevated wall bases — "higher = up-screen" matches vanilla tall-sprite convention. (b) OPT-IN camera parallax (belowParallax checkbox, default OFF; belowParallaxStrength slider 0.1-0.8, default 0.35): uniform scale about the camera ground position with k = 1 - strength/RootSize (public CameraDriver.RootSize), so screen-edge displacement equals `strength` cells at EVERY zoom — constant on-screen artifact bound, k clamped >= 0.8. Transform refreshes lazily once per frame (int compare after). The air-cell MASK stays untransformed by design: it dims the sky's holes, not the content seen through them. Side benefit: the south shift reduces the documented tall-sprite roof-edge clip.
- **Regen triggers**: dedicated MapMeshFlagDef AB_BelowThings mirrored per cell from lower-map dirty events (Harmony postfix on MapDrawer.MapMeshDirty 4-arg -> LevelSync.OnLowerMeshDirty; Things|Buildings|FogOfWar; adjacent-cell mirror for linked edges; recursion impossible). Sky Terrain flag also triggers. The mountain cap layer subscribes to AB_BelowThings too (explored-face skip reads lower fog + edifice state).
- WHY the pivot (2026-07-20): baked section meshes cover every cell and cannot skip covered ones, so tiles-over-things depended on queue math that 1.6's atlas pipeline beat in unpindownable ways. Clone band carries only flat ground layers: Terrain 300, EdgeShadows 260, Sand 285, TerrainEdges 280, TerrainScatter 275, SunShadows 255 (drop shadows come free), BridgeProps 250, Snow 90, Gas 85, Pollution 80. ThingsGeneral + BuildingsDamage clones REMOVED (below buildings lose damage scratches - accepted).
- **BelowQueueCeiling = MIN across terrain families** (Soil, RoofSurface, MountainTop, MetalTile, WoodPlankFloor mats + TerrainHard shader), measured live: vanilla terrain material queue = 2000 + renderPrecedence PER DEF (soil 2340, our rooftop 2230; in user lore). Whole below band hangs under the minimum.
- Watergen excluded + lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() per frame = real vanilla water from above; mask = fog + baseDim only over air cells; one-way mirror dynamic pass (native queues, filtered to unroofed+unfogged+air-above cells). Zero cost when the sky map is not current.
- **Async mask rebuild (ABGuard.Async)**: worker builds mask vertex buffers from live grid reads; main thread uploads; stale mesh draws while a job is in flight; any worker exception trips the guard and the sync path takes over. Only threading in the mod.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest, food, RECREATION, NEED/STATE ENGINE (two tiers: normal + MENTAL-SAFE with faction+humanlike filter). Built-ins: vanilla BingeDrug/BingeFood/Berserk/MurderousRage mental-safe; RJW family; Intimacy. Public: ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver(name, allowInMentalState). All per-pawn scan cooldowns go through the shared ABPawnCooldown helper.
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders.

## Performance architecture (post 8-tranche pass)
- **Scheduling**: ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling (lazy init + per-map stagger), never TicksGame modulo. Cadences: weather 150t, pipes 100t, climate 250t, hostile scan 250t (pocket only), sweep 2000t start + 4096 cells/tick slices, power 15t (comp-side).
- **Hidden-level throttling** (visual mirrors ONLY): weather x4 and sweep x5 while not current, instant catch-up on the visibility edge. Below-things dirty mirror accumulates flags while hidden (bit sets only); regen happens on the sky map's own normal update when viewed.
- **Colonist bar**: reorder postfix mirrors vanilla's entriesDirty via a prefix; comparator keys precomputed.
- Faux-perspective transform: one lazy per-frame rebuild (settings reads + two matrix mults), zero when no sky map is current.
- Plain-bool guards; AnySkyLevels gate; stairs memo. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## T7 optimizer-conflict audit (2026-07-19, all five active mods decompiled)
- Performance Optimizer: disjoint targets. FasterGetCompReplacement helps us. WATCH: Optimization_Pawn_DrawPos frame-cache composes with our Priority.Last offset postfix — unchanged by the faux-perspective extension (same postfix, richer vector math).
- Missile Girl (RocketMan lineage): no overlap; temp cache composes above our OutdoorTemp postfix.
- Performance Esmolas: WATCH MothballCache on hidden-level commutes (behavioral only).
- Slower Pawn Tick Rate: compatible (absolute-tick cooldowns). Dubs Analyzer: profiler only. **Zero patch-target collisions.** (MapMeshDirty postfix: pure observer, no optimizer targets it.)

## Originality audit (2026-07-19, extended 2026-07-20)
- MultiFloors: shared idea only (cross-level scan), zero shared code, no Prepatcher.
- Z-Levels beta: below-things per-cell print filter is the same IDEA as their SectionLayer_LowerThings (user-directed reference); implementation independent — they print at parallax z/y offsets with a DrawPos patch and per-type print overrides, we print straight through Thing.Print into a flag-gated layer drawn at forced band queues with an event-mirrored dedicated MapMeshFlagDef + a fog-mirrored cap skip. Our round-16 faux perspective is likewise idea-adjacent (they offset per thing at print time; we transform the whole band with one affine matrix + one DrawPos hook, camera-parallax term is ours alone). Roof visual likewise vanilla-texture-retint idea (theirs WoodFloor-as-terrain, ours GenericFloorTile steel). No foreign code or assets anywhere.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED)
- Diversion at execution; pocket incident redirect (ABIncidentLevelPolicy opt-in); pocket NPC scan (hostiles descend + assault-join; friendlies with exit duties get exit lords; never insects/vehicles).

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth (ON); cross-level caravans; column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction.

## T11 mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes (direct), DBH (direct + tankless), Rimefeller (direct-ish), Open The Windows (sky auto-roof guard + event-leak shield — VERIFIED run #118 by user), Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter.
- INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. Watch: Perspective Shift, airship traders, Real Ruins, gravships, Rimatomics steam/coolant nets.

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- XML: ABStairsExtension (deltaLevel, counterpartDef, climbFactor, utilityOnly, bridgeWater, bridgeVef, bridgeChem); ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip (tall below things just south of covered cells clip at the roof edge — REDUCED by the depth shift); no below water depth shading; mined-floor hard edges; async mask may lag one rebuild window behind fast pans; below buildings show no damage scratches. Freestanding unroofed walls below stay visible from above (locked decision).
- Faux perspective (new, bounded by the sliders): below pawns hugging the north side of a platform tuck ~0.25 cells further under the roof edge; a sub-cell sliver of terrain can peek at the south edge of fogged regions (fog's soft fade hides it); with parallax ON, roof-edge misalignment grows toward screen corners (~2x strength worst case); water shader world-space sampling shifts by the same sub-cell amount (invisible on animated water).
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs; couples-as-singles alert; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on; sweep-cadence wall edits (converges in slices).
- Utilities: DBH sewage per-level; VEF receiver turn-on cascades one appliance per net tick; hidden sky weather lags up to ~10 in-game minutes (catch-up on view); old saves drop the removed battery comp keys harmlessly.
- Open The Windows: surface windows under a platform rim go dark (porch behavior); basement windows never find an outside; pre-guard roofed decks need one manual remove-roof pass; OTW one-shot "Tried to queue null region" (cosmetic, theirs).
- T8: mounted raiders never descend; basement insects stay. World: caravan items surface-only; purchases drop at surface.
- Six comp-guard boilerplate sites still use the long form (TryLinkedLevels exists for new code).

## Status
Round-16: faux-perspective depth transform built (fixed south shift default 0.25 + opt-in camera parallax), build green, AWAITING IN-GAME VERIFICATION. Round-15 renderer arc complete and user-verified across runs #118-#123. NEXT: verify round-16 visuals, then T9 soak (long-session stability + perf on a real colony) and T5 publishing prep (Preview.png, description copy, CompatMatrix/API docs final read).
